page: UpCloud GPU-32xCPU-384GB-3xL4 is an x86_64 architecture server virtualized via KVM. It features 32 shared vCPUs and 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding 12.0 GB of RAM per core. The server is equipped with three NVIDIA L4 GPUs from the Ada Lovelace family, providing a combined total of 72 GB of VRAM.

This configuration does not include local storage, requiring users to provision external storage volumes for operating systems and data. The CPU allocation is shared, which represents a potential tradeoff in processing consistency compared to dedicated CPU instances. One complimentary public IPv4 address is included.

Given the three NVIDIA L4 GPUs and 384.0 GB of RAM, this server is designed for GPU-accelerated workloads such as machine learning inference, data science pipelines, and parallel rendering tasks. The shared CPU model offers a qualitative cost-efficiency advantage for workloads that require massive GPU and memory resources but do not demand continuous, dedicated single-core CPU performance.
description: UpCloud GPU-32xCPU-384GB-3xL4 is an x86_64 KVM-based virtual server designed for GPU-accelerated workloads. It features 32 shared vCPUs, 384.0 GB of system memory (12.0 GB per core), and three NVIDIA L4 Ada Lovelace GPUs with a combined 72 GB of VRAM. A key architectural tradeoff is the shared CPU allocation, which may introduce performance variability under sustained compute loads. Additionally, the server includes no local storage, necessitating external storage attachments. One complimentary public IPv4 address is provided. This hardware profile is qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-intensive GPU tasks, such as machine learning inference, data science, and rendering, where dedicated CPU cores are not a strict requirement but massive parallel graphics processing and substantial system memory are essential.
